points: Trim the pak choi, then thinly slice widthways. Halve the Tenderstem® broccoli widthways.
Zest and cut the lime into wedges.
steps.title: Get Prepped

points: Pour the boiled water from your kettle into a saucepan with 0.25 tsp salt and bring back to the boil.
When boiling, add the noodles and broccoli. Cook until tender, 4 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a sieve and run under cold water to stop them sticking together.
Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in another large saucepan on medium-high heat.
steps.title: Cook the Noodles and Veg

points: Once the oil is hot, add the Thai style spice blend (add less if you'd prefer things milder) and yellow Thai style paste. Stir-fry for 30 secs.
Stir in the peanut butter and coconut milk. Mix well until combined.
Mix in the sugar and water for the soup (see pantry for both amounts). Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and stir until everything's well combined.
steps.title: Soup Up

points: Add the pak choi to your soup.
Stir and cook until pak choi is tender, 2-3 mins.
steps.title: Add the Pak Choi

points: Once the pak choi is cooked, add the cooked noodles and broccoli to the soup.
Bring up to the boil again, then immediately remove from the heat.
Stir in the soy sauce and squeeze in some lime juice from a lime wedge.
Taste and add more salt, sugar and lime juice if needed.

notes.text: Add a splash of water if it's a little too thick - you want a soupy consistency!

steps.title: Combine and Stir

points: Share the noodle soup between your bowls.
Sprinkle over the lime zest to finish.
Garnish with any remaining lime wedges.
steps.title: Serve Up
